slides.title: AI Updates - 1 OpenAI In‑Chat Shopping Instant
slides.text: AI Updates - 1 OpenAI In‑Chat Shopping Instant Checkout feature in ChatGPT, lets users buy products from Etsy and some Shopify merchants without leaving the chat Payments are handled via Stripe, with no added fees for users and a small fee charged to merchants. OpenAI has reached a $500 Billion valuation following a $6.6 billion secondary share sale by employees It is now the world's most valuable startup surpassing SpaceX's $456B mark Perplexity Comet - globally Perplexity - increased hallucinations recently Gemini 2.5 Computer Use Model - Preview Controlling user interfaces (UI) by simulating actions such as clicks, typing, and scrolling in web browsers and mobile apps Access via Google AI Studio and Vertex AI, APIs, CLI or SDK Can visually understand UI layouts, generate interface actions, and automate tasks that typically require human input, such as filling forms, manipulating dropdowns, and testing UI flows https://blog.google/technology/google-deepmind/gemini-computer-use-model/

slides.title: AI Updates - 2 DeepSeek V3.2X with Sparse
slides.text: AI Updates - 2 DeepSeek V3.2X with Sparse Attention - Experimental Cuts costs for long, complex tasks by up to 50% DSA = DeepSeek Sparse Attention Model retrofits V3.1-Terminus with a learned sparse attention scheme Two step process: 1. "lightning indexer" to scan text and identify important sections 2. "fine-grained token selection system" picks top-k positions Thus the system is processing only what matters instead of everything, changing complexity from O[L^2] to O[Lk] The model is open-source on Hugging Face. IBM Granite 4.0 Open Hybrid Models Hybrid (MAMBA+ Transformer) , sizes from 3B to 32B params Using a 9:1 ratio of MAMBA 2 to transformer architecture Cutting memory use by over 70% The first open models with ISO certification for AI management. This means that IBM’s processes and safeguards around Granite models align with internationally recognized requirements for safe and responsible AI.

slides.text: AI Updates - 3 Alibaba Qwen Chat adds code interpreter and web search https://chat.qwen.ai Gemini Canvas Allows users to create fully functional web applications in minutes without writing any code. Takes videos and hundreds of documents as context when building applications; Allows conversational iteration and debugging through chat; Supports voice commands for adding features; - Generates shareable links for deployment - allowing others to access and use the web application immediately Tencent’s Hunyuan Image 3.0 beats Google’s Nano Banana Biggest open-source image-generation model https://hunyuan-image.com https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/HunyuanImage-3.0 https://www.reddit.com/r/LocalLLaMA/comments/1ny022j/open_source_texttoimage_hunyuan_30_by_tencent_is/

slides.title: Firebase Studio - create Apps in minutes Firebase
slides.text: Firebase Studio - create Apps in minutes Firebase Studio - create full Apps in minutes A cloud-based dev environment from Google Lets developers build, prototype, test, and deploy full-stack AI-powered applications directly from the browser It combines traditional coding tools with AI-powered features, integrating Gemini in Firebase, Project IDX, Genkit, and other tools to accelerate the app development lifecycle Unified Workspace - all-in-one cloud IDE, based on Code OSS (VS Code) - code, test, and deploy apps with familiar tools Agentic AI Assistance, App Prototyping Agent, Rapid Project Setup, Flexible Development, fully customizable, Integrated Firebase/Cloud Tools Firebase Studio represents Google's strategy to enable rapid AI-infused app development by combining the power of cloud IDEs, agentic AI development, and deep integration with its services and models—all accessible from a web browser https://firebase.studio https://firebase.google.com/docs/studio https://firebase.google.com/products/generative-ai

slides.title: Langflow drag-and-drop Langflow visual app builder Open-source, low-code
slides.text: Langflow drag-and-drop Langflow visual app builder Open-source, low-code platform for visually building and deploying AI applications and agentic workflows using an intuitive drag-and-drop interface It supports seamless integration with various large language models (LLMs), agents, and tools, enabling developers to rapidly prototype, test, and scale flows for tasks like chatbots, document analysis, and retrieval-augmented generation—all without extensive coding or infrastructure setup. Langflow is built atop LangChain, providing a user-friendly graphical interface while enabling export to LangChain code for advanced work https://www.langflow.org https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow - 127K stars https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dTuVpbNRO4o - video Langflow is similar to n8n in that it provides a visual, low-code pipeline builder, but Langflow is designed specifically for constructing AI agent workflows and chaining LLM components (prompts, tools, memory, and retrievers), while n8n is a more general-purpose workflow automation platform meant to orchestrate integrations between a wide variety of business apps and external services

slides.text: AI Updates - 5 OpenAI GPT-4b Model for Protein Engineering In collaboration with Retro Biosciences - https://www.retro.bio Model is trained to analyze protein sequences, cellular reprogramming, and biological interaction patterns Achieved a 50x increase in reprogramming efficiency and improved DNA damage repair in the reprogrammed cells https://openai.com/index/accelerating-life-sciences-research-with-retro-biosciences/ Intel ARC Pro B50 - 16GB GPU ~$300 compact, single-slot card 70W - via the PCIe slot (PCIe Gen 5) Runs popular LLMs (Qwen 3 4B, GPTO 20B, ...) using about 13GB out of 16GB VRAM at context 50k & generation speeds 35-52 tok/sec Intel Arc Pro B60 - 24GB at ~$500 (48GB - $1,200) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KBbJy-jhsAA - video Google CodeMender Multi-agent system detects, patches, and validates code vulnerabilities, leveraging Gemini Deep Think models for robust software security automation in open-source projects Uses static and dynamic analysis, fuzzing, and SMT solvers - to trace root causes of flaws and synthesize candidate fixes https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2j0PkVw8c1s - video https://deepmind.google/discover/blog/introducing-codemender-an-ai-agent-for-code-security/

slides.title: AI Updates - 6 Samsung Tiny Recursion Models
slides.text: AI Updates - 6 Samsung Tiny Recursion Models https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.04871 - paper https://github.com/SamsungSAILMontreal/TinyRecursiveModels Tiny - only 7M params (Millions, no Billions) Recursive reasoning neural network - recursively improves its prediction 45% on ARC-AGI-1 8% on ARC-AGI-2, beating most LLMs. Peter Diamandis Moonshots - Everything App https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bXT0PBasDc0 Massive Scale Growth; Half of all US GDP growth this year is from AI; AI is taking over. Multiple experts agree we're at a tipping point occurring within the next 6 months across robotics, autonomous vehicles, and AI capabilities. Example: OpenAI's agent builder was built end-to-end in under 6 weeks with Codex writing 80% of the code; Human typing speed is becoming the limiting factor for software development; Humans can not compete with AI Entire mechanical engineering and design being outsourced to AI with 10x cost deflation AI achieving near-superhuman performance on computer control tasks; Approx 65% of all service labor can be automated OpenAI is targeting " fully autonomous workers " as their product to justify massive compute buildouts ($800B+ in infrastructure) It is not a bubble - it is switching to new economy Acceleration: Startups need to pivot fast, constant reinvention. Can use latest AI at low cost. Token cost going down. Thus $20/month chat subscription is not justified (overpriced) The job market isn't being destroyed - it's being radically transformed from human execution to human curation and direction of AI systems The winners will be those who adapt quickly, leverage AI as a force multiplier, and focus on the human elements AI cannot replicate: creativity, strategy, and relationships xAI & Nvidia ~$20Bln Elon Musk’s xAI is raising ~$20Bln in a landmark deal with Nvidia and a other investors https://www.tomshardware.com/pc-components/gpus/nvidia-backs-20-billion-xai-chip-deal

slides.title: Every AI Founder Should Be Asking These Questions
slides.text: Every AI Founder Should Be Asking These Questions Every AI Founder Should Be Asking These Questions https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DJjZzzPANBY Talk by Jordan Fischer at Y Combinator event Unable to see beyond 3 weeks ahead rather than the 5-10 years he used to envision AGI (Artificial General Intelligence) will likely arrive within 2-3 years, fundamentally changing everything about business and society Should you plan 2 years ahead, not just 6 months, anticipating AGI? Will software become fully commoditized when anyone can prompt AI to build apps? Should UI be generated on-demand for each user? Is it better to retrofit existing products with AI or build AI-native from scratch? Will AI-native teams have advantages over traditional companies trying to adapt? How do security models change when AI agents need deep system access? Can we trust AI agents to truly act on users' behalf versus corporate interests? What constitutes a durable competitive advantage post-AGI? Are there intelligence ceilings for specific tasks that lead to faster commoditization? What problems will remain "hard" even with AGI (infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, robotics)? How can small, potentially automated companies build trust without human oversight? Should companies submit to AI-powered auditing to verify their stated values? Will we need "neutrality" standards for AI, similar to electrical infrastructure? Key Insights Both startups and enterprises will use AI As teams shrink and automation increases, establishing trust mechanisms becomes critical Some areas will stay longer (physical-world challenges, knowledge and experience (like semiconductor manufacturing) )

slides.text: Jobs Report Microsoft Research on Outsourcing Jobs to AI - July 2025 Report: "Working with AI: Measuring the Occupational Implications of Generative AI" 10 jobs with the highest risk of AI replacement: Interpreters and translators (98% coverage) Historians Passenger attendants Sales representatives of services (e.g., lawn care, cleaning) Writers and authors Customer service representatives CNC tool programmers (CNC = Computer Numerical Control) Telephone operators, ticket agents, and travel clerks Broadcast announcers and radio DJs Brokerage clerks, farm and home management educators, telemarketers, concierges, political scientists https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/publication/working-with-ai-measuring-the-occupational-implications-of-generative-ai/

slides.title: Jobs https://layoffs.fyi https://trueup.io/layoffs Tech Layoffs by year (US
slides.text: Jobs https://layoffs.fyi https://trueup.io/layoffs Tech Layoffs by year (US only): 91.3K in 2025 (as of October 9) 153K in 2024 264K in 2023 165K in 2022 https://layoffs.fyi The Tech Layoff Tracker So far in 2025, 158,055 people laid off (560 per day) In 2024, 238,461 people laid off (653 per day) https://trueup.io/layoffs Salesforce laid off 4K jobs in September 2025, primarily from its customer support division (from 9K to 5K). CEO Marc Benioff directly linked the layoffs to efficiency gains from AI ( “Agentforce” platform ), stating that Salesforce "needs fewer heads" because AI can now automate half of routine customer support tasks Salesforce previously laid off over 1,000 employees in February 2025, and thousands more in 2023 as part of an ongoing automation and restructuring initiative The job cuts are part of a wider tech industry trend where companies such as Microsoft, Meta, and Google have also replaced thousands of roles with AI-driven automation Accenture recently laid off over 11K employees (global headcount dropped from 791K down to 779K)
